let Lookback = 7d;
let Window = 1h;
let Uploads = Syslog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
  | where SyslogMessage has "SdraAnyConnectFileUploadHandler" and SyslogMessage has "../"
  | project UploadTime = TimeGenerated, Host = Computer, UploadMsg = SyslogMessage;
let Deploys = Syslog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
  | where SyslogMessage has "WFLYSRV0010" and SyslogMessage has "Deployed"
  | extend WarName = extract(@'WFLYSRV0010: Deployed "([^"]+)"', 1, SyslogMessage)
  | project DeployTime = TimeGenerated, Host = Computer, WarName, DeployMsg = SyslogMessage;
let Accesses = Syslog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
  | where SyslogMessage matches regex @'"(GET|POST) /[^/]+/[^\s]+\.jsp HTTP'
  | extend AccessedPath = extract(@'"(?:GET|POST) (/\S+) HTTP', 1, SyslogMessage)
  | project AccessTime = TimeGenerated, Host = Computer, AccessedPath, AccessMsg = SyslogMessage;
Uploads
| join kind=inner Deploys on Host
| where DeployTime between (UploadTime .. UploadTime + Window)
| join kind=inner Accesses on Host
| where AccessTime between (DeployTime .. DeployTime + Window)
| project UploadTime, DeployTime, AccessTime, Host, WarName, AccessedPath, ChainSpanMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', AccessTime, UploadTime)
| order by AccessTime desc

title: SimpleHelp Remote Access Spawning Shell or LOLBin Script Interpreter
id: 6a3f1f0a-9b1e-4d2d-8e7f-9c2b8b1f4d22
description: Detects the SimpleHelp customer-client process ('Remote Access.exe', SimpleHelp LTD) spawning shells or LOLBin script interpreters. After CVE-2026-48558, rogue OIDC-registered Technicians can drive arbitrary script execution on managed endpoints via this exact chain.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/simplehelp-bug-lets-hackers-create-rogue-remote-support-accounts/
  - https://horizon3.ai/attack-research/disclosures/cve-2026-48558-simplehelp-authentication-bypass-iocs/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/15
tags:
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.t1072
  - attack.execution
  - attack.lateral_movement
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\Remote Access.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'

level: high

2506.sent:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 15m;
let Creations = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ProcessName has "SimpleHelp" or SyslogMessage has "SimpleHelp"
    | where SyslogMessage matches regex @"(?i)technician.*?(created|registered|added)"
    | extend NewUser = extract(@"(?i)technician[^\w]+([\w._-]+)", 1, SyslogMessage)
    | where isnotempty(NewUser)
    | project CreateTime = TimeGenerated, NewUser, Computer, CreationMsg = SyslogMessage;
let PrivActions = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ProcessName has "SimpleHelp" or SyslogMessage has "SimpleHelp"
    | where SyslogMessage has_any ("remote session", "script", "group modified", "configuration changed", "role", "privilege")
    | extend ActorUser = extract(@"(?i)(?:user|technician|by)[^\w]+([\w._-]+)", 1, SyslogMessage)
    | where isnotempty(ActorUser)
    | project ActionTime = TimeGenerated, ActorUser, Computer, ActionMsg = SyslogMessage;
Creations
| join kind=inner (PrivActions) on $left.NewUser == $right.ActorUser
| where ActionTime between (CreateTime .. CreateTime + WindowMinutes)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ActionTime, CreateTime)
| project CreateTime, ActionTime, DelaySec, NewUser, Computer, CreationMsg, ActionMsg
| order by ActionTime desc

| rename user as suspectUser

    | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as actionTime values(Authentication.action) as actions values(Authentication.src) as srcIPs values(Authentication.dest) as targets from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.app="SimpleHelp" Authentication.signature IN ("RemoteSessionStarted","ScriptExecuted","TechnicianGroupModified","ConfigChanged","PrivilegeChanged") by Authentication.user

2606.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — ShinyHunters Exploits Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day (CVE-2026-35273) to Breach Univ
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("_fanout.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/etc/hosts") or FileName in~ ("_fanout.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2606.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — ShinyHunters Exploits Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day (CVE-2026-35273) to Breach Univ ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("_fanout.sh"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/etc/hosts*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("_fanout.sh"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

id: 9b3c7a4e-1f2e-4b1f-8a55-9c8e0c2dca77
description: Detects an AI agent runtime (OpenClaw/LangChain/AutoGPT-style) spawning curl/wget/PowerShell/bash with a URL argument or pipe-to-shell pattern, matching the Imperva OpenClaw PoC (TheHackerNews 2026-06-11) where a hidden contact-name prompt injection drove the agent to download and execute an attacker-hosted script.

author: SOC Detection Eng

  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.004

  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_selection:
    ParentImage|contains:
      - '\openclaw'
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3'
      - '\node.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'openclaw'
      - 'langchain'
      - 'autogpt'
      - 'agent.py'
      - 'agent.js'
  child_selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'

      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'

    | project OutTime = Timestamp, NetworkMessageId, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, RecipientDomain, Subject, AttachmentCount;

    | join kind=leftanti KnownRecipients on SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress;

    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
    | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
    | project InboundTime = Timestamp, RecipientEmailAddress, InboundSubject = Subject, InboundSender = SenderFromAddress
  ) on $left.SenderFromAddress == $right.RecipientEmailAddress
| where OutTime between (InboundTime .. InboundTime + 30m)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', OutTime, InboundTime)

let BaselineDays = 60d;

    | mv-expand Recipients
    | extend RecipientEmailAddress = tostring(Recipients)
    | summarize by SenderFromAddress = tostring(UserId), RecipientEmailAddress;
let RecentOutbound = OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OfficeWorkload == "Exchange" and Operation == "Send"
    | mv-expand Recipients

let FirstTimeOutbound = RecentOutbound
    | join kind=leftanti KnownRecipients on SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress;
FirstTimeOutbound
| project OutTime, MailboxOwner = SenderFromAddress, ExternalRecipient = RecipientEmailAddress, RecipientDomain, Subject, ClientIPAddress

  a file named shell.php with GIF-like content passed `ext_in[avatar,gif]`.

title: phpBB Password Reset Host Header Injection (CVE-2026-29199)
id: 9a3f4b21-7c1d-4e8a-bd02-2e5a1d6e0f11
description: Detects POST requests to phpBB's password-reset endpoint (ucp.php?mode=sendpassword) where the inbound HTTP Host header does not match a configured canonical hostname allow-list — the exploitation shape for CVE-2026-29199 host header injection that poisons the password-reset link to deliver the single-use token to an attacker-controlled domain.
references:
    - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/phpbb-authentication-bypass-rce
    - https://www.sentinelone.com/vulnerability-database/cve-2026-29199/
    - https://www.phpbb.com/community/viewtopic.php?t=2672170
author: thn-usecases
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
    - attack.t1190
    - attack.t1566.002
    - attack.initial_access
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
    selection_endpoint:
        cs-method: POST
        cs-uri-stem|endswith: 'ucp.php'
        cs-uri-query|contains: 'mode=sendpassword'
    filter_canonical_host:
        cs-host|contains:
            - 'forum.example.com'    # REPLACE with your phpBB canonical hostnames
            - 'www.example.com'
    condition: selection_endpoint and not filter_canonical_host
falsepositives:
    - Multi-tenant phpBB hosting with multiple legitimate canonical hostnames not in the allow-list
    - CDN / reverse proxy that rewrites Host header to an internal value before logging
    - phpBB instance bound to a raw IP address instead of a hostname
level: high
2709.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count values(Web.src) as src_ips dc(Web.src) as src_count values(Web.user_agent) as user_agents latest(Web.http_referrer) as referrer from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.http_method="POST" AND Web.uri_path="*ucp.php*" AND Web.uri_query="*mode=sendpassword*" by Web.dest, Web.http_host, _time span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| eval host_lower=lower(http_host)
| lookup phpbb_canonical_hosts_lookup canonical_host AS host_lower OUTPUT is_canonical
| where isnull(is_canonical) OR is_canonical!="true"
| where host_lower!="" AND NOT match(host_lower,"^(?:[0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}$")
| sort - count

2710.sigma:
title: phpBB Legacy OAuth Callback Access With External Referer
id: c1f2a4e8-9d3b-4a17-8e02-7c2b9f0f1d44
description: Detects access to the pre-3.3.17 phpBB OAuth callback path (ucp.php with oauth_service / mode=login_link / login=external parameters) with an external Referer header — the request shape associated with the CSRF + OAuth state-validation bypass disclosed in phpBB 3.3.17 release notes, which can silently bind an attacker-controlled OAuth credential to a logged-in victim's phpBB account. Post-patch this path is deprecated in favour of /user/oauth/authenticate/...
references:
    - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/phpbb-authentication-bypass-rce
    - https://www.phpbb.com/community/viewtopic.php?t=2672170
author: thn-usecases
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
    - attack.t1098
    - attack.t1550.001
    - attack.credential_access
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
    selection_endpoint:
        cs-uri-stem|endswith: 'ucp.php'
    selection_oauth_params:
        - cs-uri-query|contains: 'oauth_service='
        - cs-uri-query|contains|all:
            - 'mode=login_link'
            - 'login=external'
    filter_internal_referer:
        cs-referer|contains:
            - 'forum.example.com'    # REPLACE with your phpBB canonical hostnames
            - 'www.example.com'
    condition: selection_endpoint and selection_oauth_params and not filter_internal_referer
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate OAuth provider (Google, Facebook, GitHub) redirecting back to a pre-3.3.17 phpBB instance whose admin hasn't updated the redirect URI yet
    - User initiates OAuth link from an external bookmarked URL
    - Vulnerability scanner probing the OAuth callback as part of a CVE-2026-29199 check
level: medium
2710.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count values(Web.src) as src_ips values(Web.user_agent) as uas values(Web.http_referrer) as referrers from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.uri_path="*ucp.php*" AND (Web.uri_query="*oauth_service=*" OR (Web.uri_query="*mode=login_link*" AND Web.uri_query="*login=external*")) by Web.dest, Web.src, _time span=5m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| eval ext_referrer=if(match(http_referrer,"(?i)^https?://") AND NOT match(http_referrer,"(?i)://("+dest+"|forum.example.com|www.example.com)/"),1,0)
| where ext_referrer=1 OR http_referrer="-" OR http_referrer=""
| stats count, dc(src) as src_count, values(referrers) as referrer_set, values(uas) as ua_set by dest, _time
| where count>=1
| sort - _time

id: 4d8e2a91-bf36-4c72-a1d8-7e6f0c25a3b9
description: Detects unexpected child processes spawned by dwm.exe or csrss.exe, consistent with successful local exploitation of the Win32K-GRFX integer overflows CVE-2026-44803 / CVE-2026-44812. Both processes have a small, well-known set of legitimate children (conhost, fontdrvhost, WerFault) — anything else is suspicious.
references:
    - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/microsoft-patch-tuesday-for-june-2026-snort-rules-and-prominent-vulnerabilities/
author: Talos SOC
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
    - attack.t1068
    - attack.t1055
    - attack.privilege_escalation
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\dwm.exe'
            - '\csrss.exe'
    filter_benign:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\conhost.exe'
            - '\fontdrvhost.exe'
            - '\WerFault.exe'
            - '\WerFaultSecure.exe'
    condition: selection and not filter_benign
falsepositives:
    - Niche GPU driver installer behaviour that pivots through dwm in update scenarios
    - Imaging/diagnostic tools attaching debuggers to csrss
level: high
2737.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as childCmd values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name="dwm.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="csrss.exe") AND NOT Processes.process_name IN ("conhost.exe","fontdrvhost.exe","WerFault.exe","WerFaultSecure.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
2737.datadog: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) @ParentImage:(*\\dwm.exe OR *\\DWM.EXE OR *\\csrss.exe OR *\\CSRSS.EXE) -@Image:(*\\conhost.exe OR *\\CONHOST.EXE OR *\\fontdrvhost.exe OR *\\FONTDRVHOST.EXE OR *\\WerFault.exe OR *\\WERFAULT.EXE OR *\\WerFaultSecure.exe)
2737.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(dwm|csrss)\.exe$/i
| NOT ImageFileName=/^(conhost|fontdrvhost|werfault|werfaultsecure)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, IntegrityLevel], function=[count(), min(@timestamp)])

references:
    - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/microsoft-patch-tuesday-for-june-2026-snort-rules-and-prominent-vulnerabilities/
author: Talos SOC
date: 2026/06/12
tags:

    - attack.t1505.003
    - attack.execution
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:

        Image|endswith:
            - '\cmd.exe'
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
            - '\mshta.exe'
            - '\rundll32.exe'
            - '\regsvr32.exe'
            - '\certutil.exe'
            - '\bitsadmin.exe'

author: Talos SOC
date: 2026/06/12

logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\vmwp.exe'
            - '\vmms.exe'

            - '\conhost.exe'
            - '\WerFault.exe'
            - '\WerFaultSecure.exe'
            - '\vmcompute.exe'

    condition: selection and not filter_benign
falsepositives:
    - Hyper-V replica / live-migration tooling (replmgr, MeasureVM helpers) under specific Windows Server SKUs

2740.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Pythagora-io/gpt-pilot Compromised on GitHub - Shai-Hulud Credential Stealer Blo
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("__init__.py", "_index.js", "node.js", "kernel32.dll", "updater.py", "ai_setup.sh", "gh-token-monitor.sh", "token-monitor.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/tmp/.bun_ran", "/tmp/.sshu-", "/dev/stdin", "/usr/bin/env", "/dev/null", "/tmp/tmp.0144018410.lock", "/var/tmp/.gh_update_state", "/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.update-monitor.plist") or FileName in~ ("__init__.py", "_index.js", "node.js", "kernel32.dll", "updater.py", "ai_setup.sh", "gh-token-monitor.sh", "token-monitor.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2740.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Pythagora-io/gpt-pilot Compromised on GitHub - Shai-Hulud Credential Stealer Blo ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("__init__.py","_index.js","node.js","kernel32.dll","updater.py","ai_setup.sh","gh-token-monitor.sh","token-monitor.sh"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/.bun_ran*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/.sshu-*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/dev/stdin*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/usr/bin/env*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/dev/null*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/tmp.0144018410.lock*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/var/tmp/.gh_update_state*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.update-monitor.plist*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("__init__.py","_index.js","node.js","kernel32.dll","updater.py","ai_setup.sh","gh-token-monitor.sh","token-monitor.sh"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

2741.def:
let Lookback = 14d;
// Hades Campaign import hook fetches a Bun runtime zip from oven-sh/bun releases
let NetSide = DeviceNetworkEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("python.exe","python3.exe","python","python3","pythonw.exe")
  | where RemoteUrl has "oven-sh/bun/releases/download" or RemoteUrl has "github.com/oven-sh/bun"
  | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, ReportId, DeviceId;
let FileSide = DeviceFileEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
  | where FileName matches regex @"^bun-(linux|darwin|windows)-(x64|aarch64)\.zip$" or FileName =~ "b.zip"
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("python.exe","python3.exe","python","python3")
  | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, FileName, FolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ReportId, DeviceId;
NetSide | union FileSide
| order by Timestamp desc
2741.sent:
let Lookback = 14d;
ImNetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where ActingProcessName has_any ("python.exe","python3.exe","python","python3")
| where Url has_any ("oven-sh/bun/releases/download","github.com/oven-sh/bun")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, SrcUsername, Url, DstIpAddr, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
| union (
    ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where ActingProcessName has_any ("python.exe","python3.exe","python","python3")
    | where TargetFileName matches regex @"^bun-(linux|darwin|windows)-(x64|aarch64)\.zip$" or TargetFileName =~ "b.zip"
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, TargetFileName, TargetFilePath, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
  )
| order by TimeGenerated desc
2741.sigma:
title: Python Downloads Bun Runtime From oven-sh GitHub Release (Hades Campaign)
id: 7e1d4c9b-6a52-4f5a-9bda-0d3b2c4ea801
description: Detects Python processes downloading the Bun runtime ZIP from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.14/ as observed in the Hades Campaign PyPI compromise.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/pythagora-io-gpt-pilot-compromised-on-github-shai-hulud-credential-stealer-blocked-by-python-linter
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.t1105
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
      - '\pythonw.exe'
  selection_file:
    TargetFilename|re: '(?i)bun-(linux|darwin|windows)-(x64|aarch64)\.zip$'

2743.def:
// Hades Campaign Runner.Worker memory scrape — Linux /proc reads and macOS Mach VM APIs
let LinuxScrape = DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
  | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"/proc/\d+/(mem|maps)"
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("python","python3","bun")
     or FileName in~ ("python","python3","bun","cat","dd","strings");
let MacScrape = DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("python","python3")
  | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("task_for_pid","vm_region_basic_info_64","mach_task_self_","vm_read_overwrite")
     or ProcessCommandLine has "Runner.Worker";
let RunnerContext = DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("python","python3","bun") or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ ("Runner.Listener","Runner.Worker")
  | where ProcessCommandLine has "Runner.Worker";
LinuxScrape | union MacScrape | union RunnerContext
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
